title: Household income: reading beyond the headline
titleZh: 家庭收入：读懂醒目数字背后的含义
summaryZh: 以2026年10月2日发布的英国收入统计为线索，读懂中位数、可支配收入、家庭差异和样本局限；数据对应2024年4月至2025年3月。
levelReason: 较长论述保留均值与中位数、等值化及样本局限的区别；使用让步、限定和比较结构，需要跨段综合证据。 编辑估计，非认证CEFR测评。

source.name: Office for National Statistics
source.title: Average household income, UK: financial year ending 2025

attribution: Adapted from Office for National Statistics, “Average household income, UK: financial year ending 2025”, published 2026-10-02. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Dimenticato adapted the English, translated it into Chinese and added teaching notes and exercises. No official endorsement is implied.
adaptation: 英语机构原文的同语言分级改写及逐句中文翻译；排除图片、标识、所有外部直接引语和链接报告。事实日期与整理日期分开；口语问题及表达为教学补充。原语判断依据机构署名及英语编辑语境，不声称认证作者母语。

sentences.text: A headline about rising household income sounds simple, but understanding what it means requires several questions about the figures behind it.
sentences.zh: 家庭收入上升的标题听起来很简单，但要理解它的含义，需要对背后的数字提出几个问题。

glosses.note: 报刊或报道醒目的标题

sentences.text: On 2 October 2026, the Office for National Statistics published estimates covering the financial year from April 2024 to March 2025.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月2日，英国国家统计局发布了涵盖2024年4月至2025年3月财政年度的估计数据。

glosses.note: 复数，不是每户收入的精确普查

sentences.text: The publication date is therefore much later than the period described, and the results are not a direct picture of household budgets in October 2026.
sentences.zh: 因此，发布日期远晚于数据所描述的时期，结果并不能直接反映2026年10月的家庭预算。

glosses.note: 复数

sentences.text: The estimated median household disposable income was £39,200, up 3.5% compared with the previous financial year.
sentences.zh: 家庭可支配收入中位数的估计值为39200英镑，比上一财政年度上升3.5%。

glosses.note: previous financial year：上一财政年度

sentences.text: Disposable income means money available for spending or saving after direct taxes, including income tax and council tax, have been accounted for.
sentences.zh: 可支配收入是扣除所得税、市政税等直接税后，可用于消费或储蓄的钱。

glosses.note: 句首大写；disposable income是扣除直接税后的可用收入。

sentences.text: It includes not only earnings from work but also sources such as private pensions, investments and cash benefits provided by the state.
sentences.zh: 它不仅包括工作收入，还包括私人养老金、投资及国家提供的现金福利等来源。

glosses.note: 复数

sentences.text: However, the median is different from the mean, even though both are often described in everyday conversation as an average.
sentences.zh: 然而，中位数不同于算术平均数，尽管日常交流中两者常被笼统地称为平均水平。

glosses.note: 统计术语，此处与mean作明确对比。

sentences.text: The mean adds incomes together and divides the total by the number of people, so a few very high incomes can influence it considerably.
sentences.zh: 算术平均数将收入加总后除以人数，因此少数极高收入可能显著影响它。

glosses.note: 副词，修饰influence

sentences.text: The median instead represents the middle person when people are arranged from the lowest to the highest household income.
sentences.zh: 中位数则对应按家庭收入从低到高排列时，位于中间的那个人。

glosses.note: 被动语态

sentences.text: This makes the median useful for discussing a typical living standard, although no single figure describes the experience of every family.
sentences.zh: 这使中位数有助于讨论典型的生活水平，但没有一个单独的数字能描述每个家庭的经历。

glosses.note: 引出让步从句

sentences.text: Another adjustment matters because households differ in size and in the ages of the people who live in them.
sentences.zh: 另一项调整也很重要，因为家庭人口规模以及成员年龄各不相同。

glosses.note: 可数名词

sentences.text: The ONS uses equivalisation to allow for these differences when comparing incomes and the living standards they can support.
sentences.zh: 英国国家统计局采用等值化处理，在比较收入及其能够支持的生活水平时考虑这些差异。

glosses.note: 根据家庭人口数量、年龄等调整，以比较生活水平。

sentences.text: Two people generally need more money than one person, but they do not necessarily need twice as much to maintain the same standard of living.
sentences.zh: 两个人通常比一个人需要更多的钱，但要维持相同生活水平，并不一定需要两倍的钱。

glosses.note: maintain a standard：维持一个标准

sentences.text: Unless stated otherwise, the comparisons also account for inflation, helping distinguish changes in purchasing power from changes in cash amounts alone.
sentences.zh: 除非另有说明，比较还考虑通货膨胀，有助于区分购买力变化与仅仅是现金数额的变化。

glosses.note: 不可数名词，指总体价格水平上涨。

sentences.text: The report found increases in median disposable income for both the poorest and richest fifths of the population.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，人口中最贫困和最富裕的五分之一群体，其可支配收入中位数均有上升。

glosses.note: 最高级

sentences.text: Yet the Gini coefficient, a measure of inequality, fell by only 0.2 percentage points to 32.7%, leaving inequality relatively stable.
sentences.zh: 但衡量不平等程度的基尼系数仅下降0.2个百分点至32.7%，收入不平等程度相对稳定。

glosses.note: 名词；a measure of后接名词，不是形容词。
Gini coefficient：基尼系数

sentences.text: Rising income and a substantial reduction in inequality are therefore different claims, and this release does not treat them as interchangeable.
sentences.zh: 因此，收入上升与不平等显著减少是不同的判断，这份发布并未将它们等同起来。

glosses.note: 这里强调两种判断不能等同

sentences.text: The estimates also come with important limitations linked to the Household Finances Survey, which covered approximately 8,000 private households.
sentences.zh: 这些估计也伴随重要局限，涉及覆盖约8000户私人家庭的家庭财务调查。

glosses.note: 副词，用于数字之前保留近似程度。

sentences.text: Following the ending of one contributing survey, the achieved sample fell by 29% from around 11,300 households in the previous financial year.
sentences.zh: 在一项组成调查停止后，实际获得的样本量较上一财政年度约11300户减少了29%。

glosses.note: achieved sample：实际获得的样本

sentences.text: Smaller samples make detailed comparisons more uncertain, while changes in who responds can affect the composition of the households represented.
sentences.zh: 样本减少会增加细分比较的不确定性，而回应者的变化也可能影响样本所代表的家庭构成。

glosses.note: the composition of指群体由哪些成员组成。
比较级more uncertain

sentences.text: The ONS warns that estimates for retired households require particular care, and that weighting cannot completely remove all effects of this changing composition.
sentences.zh: 英国国家统计局提醒，退休家庭的估计数据尤其需要谨慎解释，加权也不能完全消除构成变化带来的所有影响。

glosses.note: 统计调整程序，不保证消除全部样本偏差。
retired households按来源定义并非全体成员均退休

sentences.text: Moreover, the survey does not include people in institutions such as care homes or hostels, or people who are homeless.
sentences.zh: 此外，这项调查不包括住在养老院、收容旅舍等集体机构中的人，也不包括无家可归者。

glosses.note: 形容词

sentences.text: Many of the poorest people may consequently be missing from its coverage, even though the estimates remain useful for examining broad patterns.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多最贫困的人可能不在调查覆盖范围内，尽管这些估计仍有助于考察总体趋势。

glosses.note: 调查覆盖哪些人

sentences.text: Reading the headline alongside these definitions and cautions gives a fuller understanding of what has changed and what the numbers cannot tell us.
sentences.zh: 将标题与这些定义和注意事项一起阅读，才能更全面地理解发生了什么变化，以及数字无法告诉我们什么。

glosses.note: 复数

words.note: 句首大写；disposable income是扣除直接税后的可用收入。
统计术语，此处与mean作明确对比。
不可数名词，指总体价格水平上涨。
名词；a measure of后接名词，不是形容词。
the composition of指群体由哪些成员组成。
根据家庭人口数量、年龄等调整，以比较生活水平。
统计调整程序，不保证消除全部样本偏差。
副词，用于数字之前保留近似程度。

sentences.note: therefore连接证据与有限的推论；interchangeable意为可互换，这里提醒两种统计判断不能等同。
even though引出让步：承认覆盖局限，同时不否定总体趋势分析的价值。

questions.text: Why might a national income figure feel different from a family’s own experience?
questions.zh: 全国收入数字为什么可能与一个家庭的亲身感受不同？

questions.text: Which matters most when you read statistics: the date, the definition or the sample?
questions.zh: 阅读统计数据时，日期、定义和样本，哪一点对你最重要？

expressions.text: The headline is useful, but it leaves out an important qualification.
expressions.zh: 标题有用，但省略了一项重要限定。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是新闻原文引语。

expressions.text: These figures describe a broad pattern rather than every individual case.
expressions.zh: 这些数字描述的是总体趋势，而不是每个个体的情况。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是新闻原文引语。
